# Pulse

> The transparent, model-driven index of global web traffic, visitor velocities, and digital platform momentum.

Pulse (https://www.pulstraffic.com) is an open internet intelligence platform tracking estimated visitor velocities, monthly traffic volumes, and rank volatility for 137 top websites worldwide. Metrics are generated by the Pulse Traffic Index (PTI v1.2), fusing verified baselines with real-time Cloudflare Radar DNS telemetry, Tranco rankings, Google Chrome User Experience (CrUX) metrics, Open PageRank authority scores, and Groq Llama 3.3 70B AI momentum classification.

## Core Documentation and Indexes

- [Global Live Dashboard](https://www.pulstraffic.com): Real-time traffic rankings, live dispatch counters, and velocity metrics across 137 global websites.
- [Data and Methodology](https://www.pulstraffic.com/methodology): Complete mathematical formulation, Zipf power-law distribution, category scaling factors, and tiered empirical validation bounds (plus/minus 8% to 12% Tier 1, plus/minus 18% to 24% Tier 2).
- [About Pulse](https://www.pulstraffic.com/about): Platform design philosophy, ground-truth benchmarks against SEC filings and Wikimedia logs, and transparent estimation limitations.
- [Country Traffic Hubs](https://www.pulstraffic.com/top-sites): Top web destinations across 115 countries localized via Cloudflare Radar national telemetry.
- [Platform Comparisons](https://www.pulstraffic.com/compare): 420+ head-to-head architectural comparisons of digital rivals (such as ChatGPT vs Google, Netflix vs YouTube, GitHub vs GitLab).
- [Trending and Volatility](https://www.pulstraffic.com/trending): Surging, growing, stable, and cooling web properties identified by real-time DNS shift analysis.
- [Weekly Internet Intelligence Reports](https://www.pulstraffic.com/report/2026-w39): Weekly deep dives into macro web traffic shifts, cloud infrastructure outages, and AI platform growth.

## Key APIs and Feeds

- [Site Enrichment API](https://www.pulstraffic.com/api/site-enrichment?domain=example.com): Returns Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID, CLS, INP), 30-day Wikipedia pageviews, and TLS/HSTS/DNSSEC security posture.
- [Outage Incident Feed](https://www.pulstraffic.com/api/outages): Real-time and historical network disruption tracker across monitored domains.
- [Sitemap](https://www.pulstraffic.com/sitemap.xml): Dynamic XML index of all 700+ canonical routes.

## Optional

- [Comprehensive Reference](https://www.pulstraffic.com/llms-full.txt): Complete technical reference including full domain catalog schema, category definitions, and benchmark confidence parameters.
